FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.q1: What is Starwise and who is it for?
FAQ.a1: Starwise is an AI-powered interview preparation app for candidates who want clearer, more structured answers. Beyond feedback, Starwise also generates improved STAR-based answers using your own experiences, so you can refine and adapt them for different interviews.
FAQ.q2: How does Starwise help me prepare for interviews?
FAQ.a2: You answer real interview questions using your own experience. Starwise analyzes your response, highlights improvements, and generates a clearer, STAR-structured version using AI - giving you a strong base that you can customize before the interview.
FAQ.a3: The STAR method stands for Situation, Task, Action, and Result. Starwise not only evaluates whether your answer follows STAR, but also rewrites your response using this structure, keeping your original experience while improving clarity and impact.
FAQ.q4: Is Starwise useful even if I already have experience?
FAQ.a4: Yes. Experienced professionals often have strong backgrounds but struggle to communicate impact clearly. Starwise uses your input to generate more concise, result-driven answers, helping you highlight what really matters in senior-level interviews.
FAQ.q5: Do I need to know the STAR method beforehand?
FAQ.a5: No. You can answer naturally. Starwise takes your raw response and automatically generates a STAR-structured version using AI, while also explaining what was improved and why.
FAQ.q6: How is AI used in Starwise?
FAQ.a6: AI analyzes your answers, identifies gaps, and generates improved versions based on your information. The goal is not to replace your voice, but to give you a high-quality baseline that you can edit, personalize, and reuse.
FAQ.q7: Can I practice for different roles and seniority levels?
FAQ.a7: Yes. Starwise offers questions by role, difficulty, and competency. For each answer, the AI adapts the generated improvement to the context of the role and level you are practicing for.
FAQ.q8: Is my data and interview content private?
FAQ.a8: Yes. Your answers are private and used only to generate feedback and improved responses for you. Starwise does not share your content with recruiters or third parties.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Our Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.description: Starwise is designed with privacy at its core. We do not store personal data, and all processing is done anonymously and securely.

s1.title: Information We Do Not Collect or Retain
s1.content:
Starwise does not collect, store, or retain personal user data beyond the transient processing strictly necessary to deliver the requested service.

This includes, but is not limited to:

list.l1: Names, email addresses, or persistent identifiers
list.l3: Audio recordings created within the App

s1.footer: User-generated content is processed only momentarily to fulfill the App’s functionality and is not retained after processing is completed.

s2.title: Temporary and Non-Identifiable Processing
s2.content: When you submit text or audio responses in the App:

list.l1: The content is processed transiently and without being associated with user identities or persistent identifiers
list.l2: No user accounts or profiles are created
list.l3: The data is used exclusively in real time to:
list.l4: Structure responses using the STAR method
list.l5: Generate interview feedback and suggested improvements

s2.footer: Once the requested processing is completed, the data is discarded and not stored by Starwise.

s3.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence Models
s3.content:
Starwise relies on third-party, cloud-based artificial intelligence services to provide its core features.

We explicitly state that:

list.l1: User inputs are transmitted without personal identifiers
list.l2: Submitted content is not used to train, fine-tune, or improve any AI models
list.l3: Data is processed solely to generate the requested output
list.l4: AI service providers act exclusively as data processors under contractual obligations and may not use the data for independent purposes

s4.title: Data Sharing
s4.content:
Starwise does not sell, rent, or share personal data.

Temporary, non-identifiable inputs may be processed by trusted infrastructure, cloud, and AI service providers strictly to enable App functionality and for no other purpose.

s5.content: To ensure app stability and performance, Starwise may collect limited, non-personal, aggregated technical information, such as:

s7.title: Legal Basis and User Rights (GDPR & LGPD)
s7.content:
The legal basis for any transient data processing under applicable data protection laws, including GDPR and LGPD, is the performance of a service explicitly requested by the user.

Because Starwise does not store personal data, most data subject rights—such as access, correction, or deletion—are inherently satisfied.

Users may still:
